job.title: Assembly technician
job.description: Assembling and testing circuit boards on the second line. You report to the line supervisor.

place: The Sacramento plant, 500 Example Boulevard, Sacramento, CA 95814

pay.overtime_rate: $36.00 an hour for overtime, $48.00 an hour for double time
pay.method: direct deposit to your bank account

hours.standard: full-time, 40 hours a week, Monday to Friday, 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. with a 30-minute unpaid meal period

leave: Paid sick leave as California law provides, and 10 days of paid vacation a year
benefits: Health, dental and vision insurance from the first of the month after your start date

state_notice.comp_carrier: Example Mutual Insurance Company, 100 Example Plaza, San Francisco, CA 94105, (415) 555-0100
state_notice.sick_leave: You may accrue and use sick leave, have a right to request and use accrued paid sick leave, may not be terminated or retaliated against for using or requesting it, and may file a complaint against an employer who retaliates
state_notice.disaster: None issued for Sacramento County in the 30 days before your first day
